content: {"episode_id":"ep-05054","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, billed with diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia. Given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events. As invited in your letter, this supporting clinical documentation is submitted to justify the medical necessity of the service."}
